title: The sound engine was rebuilt to share with iPhone
thisBuild: The engine that makes every sound was rewritten in a language the iPhone and web versions can share. It should sound exactly the same: the old and new engines were checked against each other and give identical audio.
Nothing else changed: same keys, sounds and layout as the last build.
watch: Play a few loops, a synth and a chord: does anything sound different, late or crackly?
Bounce a loop, share a mess and import a sound from your files: do they all still work?
limits: If anything sounds or acts differently from the last build, send a bug note right away. That points straight at this change.
